title: Om Nom and Candies
statementMd:
A sweet little monster Om Nom loves candies very much. One day he found himself in a rather tricky situation that required him to think a bit in order to enjoy candies the most. Would you succeed with the same task if you were on his place?

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70eb6a4f7dd2a4c72d196ff0ba5cc6b1c00e50df.png)

One day, when he came to his friend Evan, Om Nom didn't find him at home but he found two bags with candies. The first was full of blue candies and the second bag was full of red candies. Om Nom knows that each red candy weighs $*W*_{*r*}$ grams and each blue candy weighs $*W*_{*b*}$ grams. Eating a single red candy gives Om Nom $*H*_{*r*}$ joy units and eating a single blue candy gives Om Nom $*H*_{*b*}$ joy units.

Candies are the most important thing in the world, but on the other hand overeating is not good. Om Nom knows if he eats more than $*C*$ grams of candies, he will get sick. Om Nom thinks that it isn't proper to leave candy leftovers, so he can only eat a whole candy. Om Nom is a great mathematician and he quickly determined how many candies of what type he should eat in order to get the maximum number of joy units. Can you repeat his achievement? You can assume that each bag contains more candies that Om Nom can eat.

## Input

The single line contains five integers $*C*, *H*_{*r*}, *H*_{*b*}, *W*_{*r*}, *W*_{*b*}$ ($1 ≤ *C*, *H*_{*r*}, *H*_{*b*}, *W*_{*r*}, *W*_{*b*} ≤ 10^{9}$).

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum number of joy units that Om Nom can get.

## Note

In the sample test Om Nom can eat two candies of each type and thus get $16$ joy units.
statementZhMd:
一个可爱的小怪物 Om Nom 非常喜欢糖果。一天，他发现自己陷入了一个相当棘手的境地，需要稍微思考一下才能尽情享用糖果。如果你处在他的位置上，能完成同样的任务吗？

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70eb6a4f7dd2a4c72d196ff0ba5cc6b1c00e50df.png)

一天，Om Nom 来到他的朋友 Evan 家，却发现 Evan 不在家，但他找到了两袋糖果。第一袋装满了蓝色糖果，第二袋装满了红色糖果。Om Nom 知道，每颗红色糖果重 $*W*_{*r*}$ 克，每颗蓝色糖果重 $*W*_{*b*}$ 克。吃一颗红色糖果能让 Om Nom 获得 $*H*_{*r*}$ 点快乐值，吃一颗蓝色糖果能让 Om Nom 获得 $*H*_{*b*}$ 点快乐值。

糖果是世界上最重要的东西，但另一方面，吃得过多也不好。Om Nom 知道，如果他吃下的糖果超过 $*C*$ 克，就会生病。Om Nom 认为留下糖果是不合适的，所以他只能吃完整的糖果。Om Nom 是一位出色的数学家，他很快就确定了应该吃多少颗、什么类型的糖果，才能获得最大的快乐值。你能重复他的成就吗？可以假设每袋中糖果的数量都多于 Om Nom 能吃的数量。

## 输入格式

一行包含五个整数 $*C*, *H*_{*r*}, *H*_{*b*}, *W*_{*r*}, *W*_{*b*}$（$1 ≤ *C*, *H*_{*r*}, *H*_{*b*}, *W*_{*r*}, *W*_{*b*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Om Nom 能获得的最大快乐值。

## 说明

在样例测试中，Om Nom 可以各吃两颗糖果，从而获得 $16$ 点快乐值。
